source.title: Infinity Nikki Version 3.0 “Of Yesterday and Tomorrow” update live today on PS5
source.evidenceText: November 26, 2026November 26, 2026 Infinity Nikki Version 3.0 “Of Yesterday and Tomorrow” update live today on PS5 0 0 13 Like this Explore two new cities, discover new abilities and combat systems, and more. Beth Hu Global Public Relations Manager, Infold Games Explore two new cities, experience nearly 10 hours of cinematic storytelling, discover new abilities and combat systems, and celebrate Nikki’s Birthday to enjoy 160 draws in total, plus 19 sets of clothes—all free. Today we announced Infinity Nikki Version 3.0, a major update that takes Nikki and Momo’s adventure to the Twin Cities of Art: Cicia and Ceremius, which releases on PS5 later today. Featuring nearly 10 hours of immersive story with cinematic presentation, the update introduces new exploration abilities, expanded combat systems, diverse open-world activities, and a more lifelike city experience. Alongside the new content, Version 3.0 and Nikki’s Birthday bring 160 draws and 19 sets of clothes, as well as improvements that make the adventure more accessible to new and returning stylists. Twin cities of art, a new chapter: Of yesterday and tomorrow In Version 3.0, Nikki and Momo’s adventure unfolds across Cicia and Ceremius, two cities that share a common origin but could hardly be more different. Beyond everyday academy life in Cicia, the capital of art, Nikki gets caught up in strange anomalies on the streets and an investigation into the Rogues. Crossing the mist into Ceremius, she explores where the city’s past meets its present crisis, drawing ever closer to the truth about the Goddess des Arts. New abilities, combat systems, and ways to explore Across the two cities, stylists will have access to four key abilities: Veiling, Alchemy, Enhanced Floating, and Gemwork, adding more possibilities for exploration and puzzle-solving. With the Veiling Ability, stylists can throw the Shadow Beetle and choose when to teleport. When it hits certain objects, they can switch to the object’s view and control it. Combined with the city’s anomalies and mechanisms in dungeons, movement becomes part of how stylists observe their surroundings, find their way, and solve puzzles. Through Alchemy, stylists can gather materials in the open world and brew potions with Basic Recipes, or develop new recipes through trial-crafting. Potions can be used in combat, environmental puzzles, scene creation, and NPC interactions, connecting gathering, crafting, and exploration. The Enhanced Floating ability allows Nikki to jump again in midair for a nimble double jump and dash forward through the air, while the Gemwork ability lets her discover and appraise uncut gemstones across the open world, then work them into gems for outfit crafting and Alchemy. Combat also gains two new systems: firearms and magic, alongside a build system that adds depth and variety. Stylists can switch between the short musket for rapid fire and the long musket for aimed shots, while the staff allows them to cast different Oracle Arts based on their selected Nature’s Breaths and chant tiers. Combining these new ways of fighting with the build system lets stylists customize their combat style. A living open world: From the streets of Cicia to the mysteries of Ceremius In Cicia, stylists can drive through the city, run their own shop, and enjoy colorful urban life. Drive a car from Brise Automobile to complete passenger commissions, run the Warmhearted Boutique and put together outfits for customers, or discover activities such as the Scoop & Smile Creamery ice cream shop and Fuse Bead Art. Meanwhile, Ceremius lies hidden in the mist. Stylists can awaken their alchemy skills, brew potions, and explore its fantastical flora and fauna. Unique activities such as relic restoration, old photo restoration, and divination turn the local lore into hands-on play. Across both cities, immersive puzzle dungeons draw on stylists’ exploration abilities, combining miniature spaces, gear mechanisms, Rogue-style binding, and potion use to create new challenges as the story progresses. The new Star Crown outfit: as stunning as it is powerful Version 3.0 introduces the new Star Crown Resonance outfit, “Where Stars Shine Again,” alongside a lineup of new 5-Star and 4-Star Resonance outfits that combine artistic beauty with powerful abilities. The Star Crown outfit comes with two weapons, the musket and the staff. With either equipped, unused dashes can be stored and released all at once or used one at a time. The outfit also adds four step-up bonuses and a free trial entry in the event hall, giving stylists the opportunity to experience its abilities before purchasing. The new 5-Star Resonance outfit “When Light Falls Upon” unlocks Air Jumps and Air Dashes when equipped with its matching jump booster, alongside a stunning jump synergy effect. Meanwhile, the 4-Star Resonance outfits “Game for the Immortal” and “Beyond the Silence” summon chess pieces and a phantom from a fairy tale for playful interactions. More outfits in a variety of styles will also arrive through anniversary celebrations, the Heart of Infinity, direct purchases, and cumulative top-up rewards. More accessible, more lifelike: Version 3.0 Optimizations Version 3.0 introduces a more flexible starting experience for stylists. New, veteran, or returning: every stylist can head straight to Cicia. New and returning stylists can skip the standard beginner tutorial, experience a new transitional tutorial, and use chapter select to pick a starting point from any story chapter released so far. The update also enlivens the open world with large ambient NPC crowds, smoothly flowing traffic, and richer interactions across the city. Stylists will encounter taxi passengers with stories to tell, street musicians, NPCs dancing together, alchemy antics, and memorable character moments. Ray-traced visuals have also received a significant upgrade. On supported devices, crowds and vehicles are now visible in reflections and shadows at medium and long

source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for November 16 to 20
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor November 13, 2026 · 5 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Grand Theft Auto VI Rockstar Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 29730 ★★★★★ Get it now Grand Theft Auto VI – November 19 Vice City, USA. Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive. Purchase prior to 19 November 2026 23:59:59 to receive The Vintage Vice City Pack and one month of GTA+. Grand Theft Auto VI is coming to XBOX Cloud Gaming at launch! Starting November 19 at 1AM ET, you can stream it on XBOX One and XBOX Series X|S. Play it natively on XBOX Series X|S for the highest fidelity experience. Pre-install is now available, so you’re ready to play at launch. Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator astragon Entertainment GmbH ☆☆☆☆☆ 19 ★★★★★ Get it now Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator – November 17XBOX Play Anywhere In Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator, you take on the everyday responsibilities of a real park ranger in the stunning Faremont National Park. Restore and maintain scenic trails, assist visitors, and document wildlife in a living, breathing ecosystem. You’ll clear blocked paths, collect litter, fix broken signs – and occasionally drop everything to respond to urgent wildlife sightings or missing hikers. Each day brings new tasks and surprises. Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic Mindscape ☆☆☆☆☆ 1 ★★★★★ $39.99 Get it now Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic – November 17Smart Delivery You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and bond with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the series. Step into the magical world of Unicorn Academy and begin your very own adventure! Create your own first-year student at the academy and call upon the help of Unicorn Academy’s favorite characters. Groom, race and bond with your unicorn. Embark on missions to stop Ravenzella’s evil plot. Dark Rail JanduSoft ☆☆☆☆☆ 4 ★★★★★ $12.49 $9.99 Get it now Dark Rail – November 18XBOX Play Anywhere Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness. Vice: Magic City Mayhem Jurassic Sunset Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 3 ★★★★★ $14.99 Get it now Vice: Magic City Mayhem – November 18 Vice: Magic City Mayhem is a top-down 8-bit retro action/adventure game inspired by Zelda with a Vice City theme. Step into the shoes of Dutch, one of Magic City’s most feared enforcers, on a thrilling and dangerous quest to rescue your one true love, Sophie. Navigate through the chaos of wild nightclubs, scenic beaches, and raptor-infested yachts in this raunchy, high-stakes adventure. Time Machine : Hidden Objects Crisp App Studio ☆☆☆☆☆ 2 ★★★★★ $9.99 Get it now Time Machine: Hidden Objects – November 19XBOX Play Anywhere Are you brave enough to step inside a time machine and rewrite history? Welcome to a captivating hidden object adventure that takes you on an unforgettable journey through space and time. Join young scientist Herbert Fink as he faces difficult yet fascinating challenges that will test your wits. What starts as an ordinary trip out of town quickly transforms into a thrilling sci-fi detective investigation, full of deep intrigue and mysterious temporal anomalies. Cats in Wonderland Gray Boss Game Studio ☆☆☆☆☆ 6 ★★★★★ $5.99 Get it now Cats in Wonderland – November 20Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere The Queen of Hearts had a fit of rage after the Cheshire Cat refused to be her pet and ordered the capture of all the cats in Wonderland. Find them before her and prevent anything bad from happening. Cats in Wonderland is a hidden object game where you need to find all the hidden cats in Wonderland. Explore the maps, find items to access new areas, and gather the resistance to defeat the Queen of Hearts. Drill Drill Drill RainForest Game Studio ☆☆☆☆☆ 1 ★★★★★ $4.49 Get it now Drill Drill Drill – November 20 Dig deep, descend fast, and survive the darkness! DRILL DRILL DRILL is a pixel art cave-diving adventure where every floor brings new dangers, precious crystals, and a giant statue that wants to eat the very well you’re trying to escape through. Geo Book QubicGames ☆☆☆☆☆ 18 ★★★★★ Get it now Geo Book – November 20XBOX Play Anywhere Welcome to Geo Book, an engaging geography game that turns exploring the world into a fun adventure! Travel across continents, discover fascinating places, challenge your memory and put your geographical knowledge to the test through a variety of exciting mini-games. ReactorX 4 TERNOX ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $4.99 Get it now ReactorX 4 – November 20 The continuation of the adventures of the space saga ReactorX! A robot technician and captain, flying through an asteroid field, receive a mysterious SOS signal with a “request for help.” Tracking the coordinates, they are sent to an unknown mystical object in space. To get into the closed secret room, they need to turn on the power to the electrical system. There, a mystery awaits them. source.title: Thank you for making Grand Theft Auto VI the biggest launch in PlayStation history
source.evidenceText: November 23, 2026November 23, 2026 Thank you for making Grand Theft Auto VI the biggest launch in PlayStation history 77 0 598 Like this Celebrating the PlayStation community and Rockstar Games for creating an incredible moment in gaming and entertainment. Tim Turi (he/him) Content Communications Manager, Sony Interactive Entertainment After a long wait, players finally have had the chance to jump into Grand Theft Auto VI. It’s been amazing to see the PlayStation community around the world begin their adventures in the state of Leonida. Whether you’ve been counting down the days to return to the streets of Vice City or you’re experiencing the Grand Theft Auto series for the very first time, we want to take a moment to say: thank you. The excitement and passion of the community have made this a truly special moment for all of us. Celebrating a historic launch The launch of GTAVI marks an extraordinary moment for gaming and entertainment, becoming the biggest game launch in PlayStation history, across three decades and five console generations. More than 39 million unique players have experienced Jason and Lucia’s story in Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5. The PlayStation community came together in a big way to experience Grand Theft Auto VI during its launch and opening weekend. Here are a few highlights from the launch window ending November 22, 2026*: GTAVI set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation, surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles. Across PS5, players cumulatively logged an incredible 683 million hours of gameplay in GTAVI, reflecting the enthusiasm of the PlayStation community. Each player has spent an average of 17.4 hours exploring the state of Leonida during the game’s opening days. The PlayStation community has grown, as we saw the largest number of newly connected PS5 consoles on a single day since the console’s launch, outside of end-of-year holidays. Since its launch, GTAVI was the first game played on 70% of new PS5 consoles. These are just a few ways we’ve seen our PlayStation community come together around this incredible moment in gaming, and we’re excited to see how you continue to build and share new memories and experiences in the months ahead. Thank you for being part of this moment Finally, we want to congratulate our partners at Rockstar Games for bringing this extraordinary game to players around the world and continuing a partnership with PlayStation that stretches back to Grand Theft Auto III on PlayStation 2. With GTAVI, we worked to bring the best experience on PS5 and gave players a memorable way to commemorate the game with two special limited-edition DualSense wireless controllers inspired by Vice City. We also celebrated the launch with live events including Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival in Miami this past weekend.And to our PlayStation community, thank you for your continued passion and support, and for choosing to experience GTAVI on PS5. It’s your enthusiasm that make moments like these so meaningful for all of us. We can’t wait to see where your adventures in Leonida take you next! *All figures are based on SIE internal data collected from November 19, 2026, to November 22, 2026 Grand Theft Auto VIGTAVIR*Rockstar Games Did you like this?
